items.title: Antfarm Challenge
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
You were reduced to the size of an ant, and placed in an antfarm by a mad scientist!
Try to survive with the resources at your disposal in this giant antfarm but beware, you will encounter many dangers in its depths...
Will you manage to beat the Antfarm Challenge? 

- An epic survival challenge!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Anime Super Stars
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Get ready for fun times with the cool Anime Super Stars! Start playing by choosing one of these 11 cool skins!

- 11 epic anime skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Fashion Mobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
PARTY alert! You're invited to attend the coolest mob party in town. Choose between 12 stylish outfits and impress your friends with your fashion taste!

- Join the fashion party!
- 12 mob skins.
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Noob vs Pro Underground Base
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Who are you? The noob or the pro? Take a look at both secret bases. Can you find the secret room in the pro base? With 15+ rooms to explore, you won't get bored! Or do you prefer roleplay? Then this world is perfect for you!

+Great for roleplay!
+Working food farms!
+Amazing for YouTube videos!

items.title: Dreams of Horror
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Have you ever woken up from a dream filled with dread? Were you being chased? Did you fall off a cliff and wake up just before landing? Were you invisible? Were you naked in public? Whatever horror your sleeping mind conjures up, it's time to take control by living out your worst nightmares in this artistic skin pack. 

- 10 skins, including 1 free
- Created by G2Crafted

items.title: Ace of Space
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Beep boop blarg! Oh sorry, didn't see you there. In this space themed skin pack you'll be ready for all sorts of otherworldly adventures. Become an alien ranger, how about a planet? Or maybe even hide out as an alien in human disguise! The possibilities are endless!

- 18 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: TV Heads
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Forget asking what's on TV, the TV is on you this time! 

*16 TV skins
*2 skins free

items.title: Elemental Warriors
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Fire, earth, air, and water! The four elements have now their warriors, ready to fight against the evil creatures and ready to explore new lands. Choose the one that fits you the most and start a new adventure!

+ 10 skins
+ By Agora Studios

items.title: Cute Neko Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Meow! These cute neko teen skins are colorful and fun for any occasion. With modern and trendy attire these colorful cat ears are a great accent to your next favorite skin!

+ Perfect for teens
+ Great for roleplay
+ 12 skins

items.title: Anime Matsuri
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
A new festival is here and everyone is getting lively! Dressing in the spirit of the season is definitly the way to go! Show off your festive vibes!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Traditional, luxury attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Anime Style
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Have you ever felt like an anime character? Anime Style is the perfect skin pack for you with many different cute skins to choose from! Whether you’re going to roleplay in a Japanese high school setting, or if you simply want to look awesome in singleplayer, this skin pack has an outfit that perfectly matches your personality!

- 12 cute anime skins!
- Perfect for teens!

items.title: Craftable Boats
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft your own boats, hovercrafts, and submarines! Boost over the waves in a water jet pack. Explore hidden ruins and learn new crafting recipes.
- 12 new crafting recipes
- Boats, hovercrafts, jet skis, aqua packs, and more
- Hidden collectibles
- Sharks and crocodiles
- 5 skins
- Survival, roleplay, and multiplayer

Explore the ocean on a boat you crafted yourself!

items.title: Animals Super Heroes
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Become an animal superhero and start some great adventures, today!
Remember, the sky is the limit!

+ 5 skins, turning your favourite animals into ultimate superheroes!
+ Protect your world and spread the positive vibes!
+ By Senior Studios & Daylight Studios!

items.title: Experimental Skyblock
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Explore this new skyblock scientifically created just for you! Discover what lays behind each experiment!

-8 unique islands to discover with a different challenge for each one
-4 free skins
-By inPixel & Evershapes

items.title: Skylands Adventure
items.creator: Pixelbiester
items.description:
Explore colorful Skylands and search for hidden treasures filled with great rewards. But watch out for enemies. Jump through the sky parkour and help the cute Mr. Morris to unlock new islands and collect all trophies.

+ 2 free skins
+ Several unique Skylands
+ Unique textures and mobs
+ Special island soundtracks
+ Adventure or survival mode

Also works in multiplayer!

items.title: Stoneland Valley
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Stoneland Valley is an incredible kingdom on an island, with a large castle and many houses!

items.title: BajanCanadian Fashion
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
BajanCanadian's official Minecraft squad is finally here! 
What are you waiting for? Join it today and bring your favourite YouTuber to all your worlds!

+ 12 skins, spreading his famous fashion style across Minecraft!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

+ In partnership with BajanCanadian!

items.title: Glitched!
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Uh oh, it looks like these skins have glitched out! From missing textures to corrupted files, something has gone terribly wrong!

- 8 glitched skins!
- Many different broken textures sure to freak everyone out!

items.title: Crazy Lucky Block Bed Wars
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Play the classic Bed Wars that you know and love, but with a crazy lucky block twist! To help you destroy the bed from your opponent, you get crazy loot from the lucky blocks such as:

- Mini airplanes
- Mini cars
- TNT and dynamite
- Custom gear

and much more. Be careful though, because you can also be crazy unlucky with dangerous events.
(2 players required to play)

items.title: Great Warriors of the Past
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The time has come for these ancient warriors to shine once again. Choose from legendary heroes of the past from all around the world and bring their fury upon mobs.

+ Medieval
+ Roleplay
+ Knight
+ By In Mine

items.title: Anime Stylish Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Anime stylish teens are the right choice for a true fashionable kid. Choose your style and join the game as an anime character with an outstanding look.

+ Teens fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Adventurous Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
How about going on an adventure? These great skins are designed for avid adventurers. You can show your courage by getting these skins!

- 10 skins included.
- Best suited for going on trips!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Planet Studios.

items.title: Hacker Mobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Mobs have started their training to become elite Minecraft hackers! This team will be the very best someday!

- 12 skins
- Animal and mob costumes
- Roleplay as a hacker!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Advanced Camo Bricks
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
From the people who brought you the best camo pack ever, have only gone and made a best ever brick version.

One free skin!
